data.explanation: Your driving school has booked your practical driving test for 7 January 2027 at 07:30 at the test center (Prüfstelle) on Industriestraße 30. Bring your ID card (Personalausweis) with you — your instructor will meet you there. The exam fee has already been paid, so no further payment is needed for this appointment. If you cannot make it, contact the driving school as soon as possible to reschedule, since missing the appointment without notice could mean losing the paid fee or having to pay again for a new date.
